Predict Hard Classes from a Fast Classification Forest

Source: R/rf_fast_wrappers.R
rf_predict_fast_class.Rd

Generates hard-class predictions from a classification forest fitted with rf_class_fit_fast(). This is a lower-level prediction interface. Most users should use rf_class_predict_fast().

Usage

rf_predict_fast_class(X, forest_list)

Arguments

X

A numeric matrix containing predictor values. The columns must correspond, in number and order, to those used to fit forest_list.

forest_list

A fitted classification forest returned by rf_class_fit_fast().

Value

An integer vector of length nrow(X). Each element is the predicted class index for the corresponding observation. For a binary model fitted with classes encoded as 0 and 1, the returned values are 0L or 1L.

Examples

set.seed(614)

X <- cbind(
  x1 = rnorm(30),
  x2 = rnorm(30)
)

y <- as.integer(
  X[, "x1"] + X[, "x2"] > 0
)

forest <- rf_class_fit_fast(
  X,
  y,
  n_trees = 5L,
  max_depth = 3L,
  mtry = 1L,
  use_gini = TRUE
)

predictions <- rf_predict_fast_class(
  X,
  forest
)

head(predictions)
#> [1] 1 0 1 0 0 0

stopifnot(
  is.integer(predictions),
  is.null(dim(predictions)),
  length(predictions) == nrow(X),
  all(predictions %in% c(0L, 1L))
)
